communities.name: Missing workload pods / admission rejection
communities.symptom: Expected replicas or pods are absent while sibling workloads run; controllers show FailedCreate or admission denial and no pod object exists.

communities.name: Pods Pending, ContainerCreating, or node-scoped startup failure
communities.symptom: New or affected pods stay Pending/ContainerCreating with no node assignment or pod IP, often on one node or with scheduler/kubelet/runtime unhealthy.

communities.name: Service/route unreachable with healthy pods
communities.symptom: Clients cannot reach a Service or route while backing pods are Running/Ready; failures are connection refused/timeout/404/no-such-host and endpoints may be empty, wrong, or node-local.

communities.name: Deterministic 5xx/503 on specific application paths
communities.symptom: Pods are Running/Ready with stable restarts and Services have endpoints, but specific request paths or business actions return deterministic 5xx/503 errors.

communities.name: Application-code latency or CPU-bound slowdown
communities.symptom: One healthy workload shows sharp latency or CPU/throttling increase without restarts, traffic surge, downstream latency, or node-wide saturation.

communities.name: Pod-scoped network delay
communities.symptom: Latency or throughput degradation is isolated to one pod/workload while pods stay Running/Ready, endpoints populated, restarts zero, and resources/dependencies normal.

communities.name: Node-scoped packet loss/network degradation
communities.symptom: Multiple unrelated pods co-located on one node show simultaneous latency inflation or packet-rate/retransmit anomalies while pods elsewhere remain normal.

communities.name: CrashLoop/OOM/restarts in one workload
communities.symptom: One workload is CrashLoopBackOff or repeatedly restarting with OOMKilled/exit 137 or rising restarts while peer pods and dependencies remain healthy.
